title: Valid Anagram
summary: Decide whether two words use exactly the same letters the same number of times.

tests.explain: Both words use d, u, s, t and y exactly once each.
"teeth" has two t's and no m; "theme" has one t and an m.
Different lengths can never be anagrams.

hints: Two words are anagrams when every letter appears the same number of times in both. Order doesn't matter.
If the lengths differ, the answer is false straight away.
Count the letters of s (a Map, or an array of 26 counters), then subtract the letters of t. Any counter that drops below zero means false.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass over each string
complexity.space: O(1): at most 26 counters (O(k) for an alphabet of size k)
